central_idea.text: Separate accepting an event from processing it. A durable queue absorbs bursts; workers retry safely, and an idempotent sink prevents repeated delivery from changing the result twice.

diagram.description: Follow an event from acceptance to a durable result. Acknowledgement follows a successful write.

edges.label: Deliver with a lease; redeliver after expiry.

essential_notes.heading: Durability
essential_notes.text: Acceptance means the event is stored, not that downstream work has finished. A lost acknowledgement can cause the producer to send again.

essential_notes.heading: Idempotency
essential_notes.text: Use a stable event identifier. Repeating the same operation must have the same observable effect; an identifier generated on each retry defeats deduplication.

essential_notes.heading: Backpressure
essential_notes.text: Watch queue age as well as queue length. Limit admission or slow producers when consumers cannot keep up, rather than buffering without a bound.

essential_notes.heading: Ordering
essential_notes.text: Parallel consumption improves throughput but can reorder events. Partition by entity when ordering is required within an entity, while allowing independent entities to progress.

comparison_rows.heading: Delivery vs effect
comparison_rows.text: At-least-once delivery can duplicate work. Idempotent writes protect effects, but do not make transport exactly once.

comparison_rows.heading: Retries vs poison events
comparison_rows.text: Transient failures can recover on retry. Persistently failing events need a bounded retry policy and a separate inspection path.

comparison_rows.heading: Throughput vs ordering
comparison_rows.text: More consumers increase parallelism only when independent work exists. A single hot partition remains a bottleneck.

recall_cues.heading: Reconstruct
recall_cues.text: Explain the acceptance boundary, retry boundary, and the identity used to deduplicate.

recall_cues.heading: Failure drill
recall_cues.text: What happens if a worker crashes immediately after the sink write but before acknowledgement?
